headline: AgentPProf adds semantic resource profiling across long-horizon agent runs
summary: A Sep. 14 arXiv paper introduces AgentPProf, which segments agent trajectories into nested semantic task intervals and folds token, time or operation counts into standard pprof profiles. In the paper's evaluations, it reaches 0.764 B³ F1 against human stage labels and improves mean average precision when combined with direct diagnostics on three problem-localization benchmarks. These are author-reported results; independent replication and broader multi-project evaluation remain open.
